name: ERIUS PHONE (uvx)
description: Drive a hosted ERIUS PHONE Android phone or tablet: read the screen as an accessibility tree or screenshot, tap, type, swipe, launch apps, install APKs, and pull crash logs.

inputs.label: ERIUS PHONE API Key
inputs.description: API key for your ERIUS PHONE account. Every request is authenticated with it and scoped to your own devices.

obtain.instructions:
1. Request early access at https://eriusphone.com
2. During early access the ERIUS PHONE team provisions your device by hand and sends you the API key and device id
3. Paste the key here

inputs.label: Default Device ID
inputs.description: Device id to use when a tool call does not name one. Leave empty to pass the device on each call; list_devices shows the ids.

auth.instructions: ERIUS PHONE is in early access. Request access at https://eriusphone.com; the API key and device id are issued by the ERIUS PHONE team.
